stem: Pyruvate dehydrogenase processing yields a two-carbon unit that enters the citric acid cycle. What is that product called?

options.label: A
options.misconception: None; the compound formed is acetyl CoA.
options.explanation: OpenStax names the pyruvate-derived compound acetyl CoA.

options.label: B
options.explanation: It is the cycle partner, not the pyruvate product.

options.label: C
options.explanation: Not the immediate pyruvate dehydrogenase product.

options.label: D
options.misconception: A glycolytic intermediate upstream of pyruvate.

options.label: E
options.misconception: Citrate is the first condensation product after acetyl-CoA entry.

context: Learning objective: identify acetyl-CoA as the pyruvate-derived citric-cycle entry unit.
imageCaption: Cellular respiration: glycolysis -> pyruvate -> acetyl-CoA -> citric cycle carriers -> ETC/ATP synthase; O2 terminal acceptor; fermentation regenerates NAD+.
